note_on_internal_prefix: Some scripts/caches retain the legacy HOSH method identifier for backward compatibility; public labels in figures and tables are MSH.

preprocessing.weights_or_repeated_interactions: aggregated to a single unweighted edge
preprocessing.temporal_interactions: aggregated to a static unweighted graph
preprocessing.node_labels: relabel to consecutive integers starting from 0

sir_main.update: synchronous; infection attempts first, then recovery; newly infected nodes become infectious in the next step

tie_breaking.main_rule: ascending node ID after relabeling for tied scores
tie_breaking.monotonicity_rule: no ID tie-breaking; identical scores are treated as tied groups

synthetic_runtime.memory_profiling: not included; efficiency claims are restricted to runtime behavior
